'''Maitorieska''' (''milk rieska'', pronounced "RE-ehskuh") is a [[Cookbook:Barley|barley]]-based [[Cookbook:Flatbread|flatbread]] that is a local specialty and a very traditional food in the Ylivieska area of [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Finland|Finland]].

==Ingredients==

* 250 [[Cookbook:mL|ml]] (1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]]) cold [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]]
* ⅓ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 250–330 ml (1–1½ cups) [[Cookbook:Barley|barley]] [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]]

==Procedure==

# Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to 300°C (570°F), or as high as it will go. 
# Combine milk and salt, and add flour. Mix the ingredients well to make a [[Cookbook:Dough|dough]].
# [[Cookbook:Knead|Knead]] into a flat, round bread (about 0.5 cm / ¼ [[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] thick). 
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] on an [[Cookbook:Oven Tray|oven tray]] for about 10 minutes or until the surface gets some darker spots. Alternatively, [[Cookbook:Pan fry|fry it in a pan]] on the stove or on open fire.
# Eat fresh with [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]] and cold milk.
